summary: NetEase, Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching its monthly return to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange for September 2026. The routine disclosure covers movements in authorized capital and issued shares, showing issued shares rising 401,170 to 3,201,652,151 while treasury shares fell 401,170 to 10,403,505, keeping total issued shares at 3,212,055,656. Authorized capital is unchanged at 1,000,300,000,000 ordinary shares. The filing confirms compliance with the 25% minimum public float requirement. This is an ordinary HKEX monthly return, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
